cameraInstructions: Film from the front with the full body, both hands, and both feet visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep your body within 10 degrees of upright.
metrics.hint_good: Great control. Your body stayed upright while you jumped.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned to the side. Tighten your core and keep your chest facing forward.

metrics.targetText: Land with each knee pointing in the same direction as the toes.
metrics.hint_good: Nice landing. Your knees stayed lined up with your feet.
metrics.hint_high: A knee moved away from the leg line. Land softly and point both knees toward the toes.

metrics.targetText: Open your feet to about 1.4-2.4 times shoulder width.
metrics.hint_good: Your feet opened to a strong, controlled width.
metrics.hint_low: Open both feet a little wider when your arms rise.
metrics.hint_high: Bring the feet slightly closer so the landing stays controlled.

metrics.targetText: Raise both hands clearly above shoulder height as the feet open.
metrics.hint_good: Your arms rose at the right time and reached a clear height.
metrics.hint_low: Lift both hands higher when your feet open.
metrics.hint_high: Keep the arms long but relax the shoulders instead of forcing them upward.

metrics.targetText: Make each foot opening about the same width.
metrics.hint_good: Each jumping jack opened to a similar width.
metrics.hint_high: Some openings were wide and others were small. Aim for the same foot position each time.

metrics.targetText: Keep an even rhythm from one jumping jack to the next.
metrics.hint_high: The movement sped up and slowed down. Use one steady beat.
